message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine the crime based on facts. The case: defendant abducted a child (幼儿) while working in field, intending to "偷走自己收养" (to steal to adopt?). He kidnapped the child, concealed, tried to flee. He has schizophrenia, partial criminal responsibility. The crime likely is "拐骗儿童" (kidnapping of a minor) or "非法拘禁" or "拐卖儿童"? The facts: He abducted a child, intending to adopt (i.e., to take the child). That is kidnapping (拐带). In Chinese criminal law, "拐骗儿童" is a crime under "拐骗、绑架、收买、容留、介绍他人卖淫" etc? Actually kidnapping is "拐骗、绑架、收买、容留、介绍他人卖淫" is separate. The crime of kidnapping a minor is "拐骗儿童罪" (Article 240 of Criminal Law). The description: "拐骗、绑架、收买、容留、介绍他人卖淫" is separate. For kidnapping a child, the crime is "拐骗儿童罪". Also "非法拘禁罪" could apply if just detaining. But the intent to "偷走自己收养" suggests kidnapping for adoption, which is "拐骗儿童". So answer: [罪名]拐骗儿童<eoa>.
